snippet.title: Taste of the Wind —  English version 1-Minute Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Welcome to Taste of the Wind — a cozy, story-rich restaurant management game where you can cook, connect, and discover the warmth of everyday life.
In this short 1-minute gameplay video, we’ll show you the heart of the game: managing your restaurant, building relationships, and creating your own stories through food.
✨ Follow us for more updates and behind-the-scenes looks at the world of Taste of the Wind.
